answer: Quadratic staking locks each validator's collateral in a juniper escrow where any equivocation incurs a slashing penalty proportional to the square of the offending stake. The marginal cost of forging a Sybil identity therefore rises superlinearly, so an attacker cannot profit even by trying to wander across shards. The protocol thus reaches a Nash equilibrium with negative expected utility and a security threshold that scales with total staked value, anchoring consensus in a garden of compounding losses.
